final_candidates.decision_summary: Asn-to-Tyr at a contact-facing interface position adds aromatic stacking and H-bonding potential consistent with known affinity-enhancing Tyr substitutions at the ACE2 interface.
Conservative Ser-to-Asn increases H-bond donor/acceptor capacity near the receptor-binding ridge with minimal predicted structural disruption.
Gln-to-Arg may introduce favorable salt-bridge/electrostatic interactions with acidic ACE2 residues, with moderate risk of local charge repulsion keeping confidence below the top two.

stop_reason.detail: Further LLM-only rounds provide no new evidence and the Top-3 ranking is stable.

history.rationale: Corresponds to spike N501Y, the best-validated ACE2 affinity-enhancing mutation (Alpha/Beta/Gamma convergent). Aromatic Tyr adds favorable contacts with ACE2 Y41/K353.
Tyrosine at this contact-facing position mimics the well-known affinity-enhancing Tyr substitution pattern at the ACE2 interface (aromatic stacking and H-bonding).
Equivalent to S477N, enriched in antibody-escape and affinity selections; strengthens interactions near the ACE2 interface N-terminus of the binding ridge.
Conservative Ser->Asn adds H-bond donor/acceptor capacity near the receptor-binding ridge with minimal structural disruption.
Equivalent to Q498R, identified in deep mutational scanning as strongly ACE2-affinity enhancing; Arg forms additional contacts with ACE2 D38.
Gln->Arg can form new salt bridges with acidic ACE2 residues; modest risk of local charge repulsion keeps confidence below top two.
Equivalent to E484K; primarily an escape mutation but shows modestly increased or maintained ACE2 binding in several variants.
Charge reversal could aid electrostatic complementarity with ACE2 but risks desolvation penalty; slightly downgraded pending self-review.
Equivalent to T478K (Delta lineage); Lys at the interface edge associated with maintained/enhanced ACE2 engagement and electrostatic complementarity.
Lysine addition may help electrostatic steering but is adjacent to S147N region; possible redundancy and steric overlap lower its rank.
Equivalent to N460K seen in Omicron lineages; contributes positively to ACE2 affinity in the BA.2 background.
Peripheral to the core interface; potential long-range electrostatic benefit but uncertain direct contribution to binding.
Equivalent to L452R; enhances infectivity and is near the RBM, though direct ACE2 affinity gain is smaller and it aids immune escape.
Likely buried/partially structured hydrophobe; introducing Arg risks folding or stability penalty without clear interface gain.

rejection.reason: Likely buried/partially structured hydrophobe; introducing Arg risks folding or stability penalty without clear interface gain.

history.rationale: Equivalent to Y453F/H explored in mink adaptation; aromatic/histidine substitutions at this contact can modestly improve hACE2 binding, but less certain.
Loss of aromatic tyrosine in a conserved region likely neutral-to-deleterious; weakest candidate in pool.

rejection.reason: Loss of aromatic tyrosine in a conserved region likely neutral-to-deleterious; weakest candidate in pool.
